item.title: Trump: US defeating Iran, war will end very quickly
item.description: President Trump says the US is defeating Iran and predicts the war will end quickly, reiterating that Iran will not be allowed to have nuclear weapons.

item.title: Hundreds of haredi protesters gather outside draft evader's home in Modi’in
item.description:
Hundreds of haredi protesters gathered overnight outside the home of a draft evader in Modi’in to protest his arrest.
The protesters attempted to break into the draft evader's apartment building. Following clashes between the protesters and police at the scene, the draft evader was released.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition launches Yemen operation against Houthis
item.description: Saudi-led forces launch an operation in Yemen as government troops battle the Iran-backed Houthis, who claim missile and drone attacks on Saudi targets.

item.title: 35-year-old man moderately injured while riding electric scooter in Tel Aviv
item.description:
A 35-year-old man was moderately injured while riding an electric scooter on Dizengoff Street in Tel Aviv.
Magen David Adom (MDA) teams provided him with medical treatment before evacuating him to Ichilov Hospital in the city.

item.title: Poll: Winter drifts further below electoral threshold
item.description: A Channel 12 News poll gives Ofer Winter’s Amcha Yisrael party just 1.5%. The coalition bloc wins 49 seats, compared with 54 for the opposition.

item.title: Watch: Chilling footage from Soroka Hospital on October 7th
item.description: Watch the special broadcast from Kan 11: Chilling footage from Soroka Hospital on October 7th revealed for the first time, alongside the heroic battle of the medical staff to save lives.

item.title: Trump confirms: US moved bombers from UK base over threat
item.description: President Trump confirms the US removed bombers from RAF Fairford over a threat, says he believes Iran was behind the attempted Flydubai attack.

item.title: Avinatan Or reveals: I opposed a hostage deal even deep in captivity
item.description: Former hostage Avinatan Or says he opposed a deal that could lead to future abductions: “It was clear to me that Israel needed to emerge victorious from this war."

item.title: Jonathan Spencer blasts ‘NAZA’ documentary: ‘Worse than Hamas propaganda’
item.description: Urban warfare expert Jonathan Spencer accuses documentary of spreading “lies, lies by omission, and lies of ignorance," takes particular aim at claim that Israel killed more than 73,000 in Gaza.

item.title: Iran’s new weapon: Female soldiers
item.description: Iran has begun training women for combat against the US and Israel. Among other things, they are learning to operate weapons and conduct urban warfare.

item.title: Suspect admits: Attempted hijacking was ‘revenge for Gaza’
item.description: Hamam al-Hammami, suspected of attempting to crash the Flydubai plane told investigators that he wanted to “die as a shahid."

item.title: Rival fans, brothers in captivity: Jerusalem mural honors Ori and Hersh
item.description: New Teddy Stadium mural honors Ori Danino and Hersh Goldberg-Polin, rival Jerusalem soccer fans who forged a powerful bond in Hamas captivity.

item.title: Life sentence for terrorist who attempted attack on Israeli Embassy in Britain
item.description: A British court sentenced a man of Kuwaiti origin to life in prison after he attempted to break into the Israeli Embassy in London last year and carry out a stabbing attack.
